name: Daniel Torrealba
summary: Specialized in backend development and system integrations, leveraging 5+ years in digital transformation and automation across finance and ERP domains. Combines hands-on development in Ruby on Rails, Python/Django, and Java/Spring with a strong foundation in Agile methodologies and cloud platforms (AWS Certified).

experience.description:
- Automated accounting centralization process using Ruby, cutting runtime from 3+ hours to 25 minutes, processing 180K+ monthly records via parallel batch.
- Designed and implemented 23+ integrations between Buk and external ERPs (NetSuite, SAP B1, Softland), processing 2.5M+ transactions/month, including retry logic architecture and OAuth 2.0 handling.
- Eliminated operational bottlenecks (N+1 Queries) by automating SQL extractions (Active Record) that process 3 years of historical data in <2 min vs. 45+ min previously.
- Reduced the Project area's technical dependency by 60% through structured training on accounting integration tools and the development of internal technical documentation

- Improved data pipeline reliability by 30% through validation and exception handling.
- Developed Python automation scripts (using Pandas & Docker) to process investment reports, reducing manual task generation time from 2 hours to 10 minutes.
- Worked in conjunction with technical and business teams to identify areas for improvement and apply innovative technological solutions that supported strategic decision-making.

- Led the digitization of inventory (ERP implementation), sales reception, cash reconciliation and payment management (payment gateway implementation) of the company's 5 branches nationwide.
- Trained more than 30 employees in the use of management software (ERP).
- Implemented digital stock control tools that improved operational efficiency at a corporate level.

education.description: Focus: Software development, databases, agile methodologies
